# Behind the Name

> The web's most comprehensive database of given name meanings, origins, etymologies, and popularity statistics across cultures and languages.

Behind the Name is a 30-year-old onomastics resource offering searchable name databases, popularity rankings, famous namesakes, name days, and community tools. The site includes companion resources for surnames and place names, making it a complete etymology and naming reference platform.

## Key Topics

- name meanings
- name origins
- name etymology
- baby names
- given names
- name popularity
- name rankings
- name history
- multilingual names
- name database
- famous namesakes
- name days
- community forums
- name submission
- name search

## Core Name Search & Discovery

- [The Meaning and History of First Names](https://www.behindthename.com): Homepage: search given names for meanings, history, and popularity
- [Name Meanings](https://www.behindthename.com/meanings): Reverse dictionary: browse given names by their meanings and attributes
- [Baby Name Expert](https://www.behindthename.com/guide): Interactive tool to find ideal baby names based on preferences
- [The Most Popular Names](https://www.behindthename.com/top): Rankings of most popular given names globally and by country

## Companion Sites

- [The Meaning and History of Surnames](https://surnames.behindthename.com): Companion site: search surname meanings, origins, and usage statistics
- [The Meaning and History of Place Names](https://places.behindthename.com): Companion site: explore place name etymologies and geographic origins

## Name Reference & Research

- [Submitted Names](https://www.behindthename.com/submit): Browse user-submitted names and their etymologies across languages
- [Namesakes](https://www.behindthename.com/namesakes): Reference tool: famous namesakes organized by name and category
- [Name Days](https://www.behindthename.com/namedays): Reference: name days and saint feast days from worldwide cultures
- [About Names & Etymology](https://www.behindthename.com/info/names): Educational guide to onomastics, etymology, and given name origins

## Community & Engagement

- [Message Boards](https://www.behindthename.com/bb): Community forums to discuss name meanings and get baby name advice
- [Polls](https://www.behindthename.com/polls): Interactive community polls about name preferences and favorites
- [Games and Quizzes](https://www.behindthename.com/games): Interactive games and quizzes testing knowledge of names and meanings
- [Prediction Game](https://www.behindthename.com/derby): Contest: predict next year's most popular US baby names with prizes

## Contribution & Guidelines

- [Submit a Given Name](https://www.behindthename.com/submit/submit): Guidelines and form to contribute new given names to the database

## Optional

- [This Site is 30!](https://www.behindthename.com/info/30years): Celebrates behindthename.com's 30th anniversary with site statistics
